grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: Education Changes: A Conversation About Learning
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先阅读题目，听录音时注意说话者使用的时态和关键词。录音播放两遍。
transcript:
M: Hi, Lisa. I haven't seen you for a long time. How are you?
W: I'm fine, thanks. I've just finished my English course. I started it three years ago.
M: Three years? That's a long time. Have you taken any exams yet?
W: Yes, I've already passed the B1 exam. I took it last month.
M: Congratulations! So you've been a student at the language school since 2020?
W: That's right. I've studied there for three years. But I've also started teaching children English online.
M: Really? You're a teacher too? How long have you been doing that?
W: I've taught online for six months. I began in January.
M: That's interesting. Have you noticed any changes in your students since you started?
W: Yes, they've become more confident. At first, they didn't speak much, but now they ask questions.
M: Have you changed your teaching style?
W: I have. I've used more games recently. I didn't use games before.
M: What about your own studies? Have you stopped learning?
W: No, I haven't. I've just started a new course in teaching. I haven't finished it yet.
M: You're busy! Have you ever thought about teaching in a school?
W: Not yet. I've worked online only. But I've thought about it since last year.
M: Well, good luck with everything.
W: Thanks!

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或从过去持续到现在的状态。常与already（已经，用于肯定句）、yet（还，用于否定句和疑问句）、since（自从，后接时间点）、for（持续，后接时间段）连用。一般过去时表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作，常与明确过去时间状语连用。
grammar.example: I've already passed the B1 exam. I took it last month.

questions.explanation: already常用于现在完成时肯定句，结构为has + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: She has finished her homework already.

questions.explanation: last year是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时。
questions.evidence: They went to London last year.

questions.explanation: since后接时间点（2010），表示从那时持续到现在。
yet用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还（没）”。

part1: Have you ever taken an English course?
How long have you studied English?
Have you noticed any changes in your learning since you started?
Have you ever thought about teaching English?
speaking.part2: Describe a change in your education that you have experienced. You should say:
part2_bullets: and explain why you think it is important.
part3: How has education changed in your country in recent years?
Do you think online learning has improved education? Why?
What changes do you think will happen in education in the future?
Have you ever taught someone something? What was it?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 80 words) about a change in your studies. Use the present perfect with already, yet, since, or for, and the past simple for finished actions.
